artworks.title: The Petitioning Vintners
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of men standing before an authority figure. The scene shows four men on the left side facing the authoritative figure on the right, who is gesturing. The setting is indoors with a window in the background showing buildings outside. Two chairs and a dog are in the middle ground. Speech bubbles are depicted coming from the human figures' mouths. The style and attire suggest a historical context, with exaggerated expressions and postures. The artwork is in a monochromatic, linear style typical of engravings or etchings from the 18th century.

artworks.title: The Death of Doge Marino Faliero
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene inside an architectural setting. The drawing shows robed figures standing on elaborate stairs with carvings. Banners or drapes are hanging overhead. The setting suggests importance, possibly a palace or cathedral, with detailed stonework and arches. In the foreground, figures are seen in different postures, with one figure lying on the ground. The drawing uses detailed line work to depict textures.

artworks.title: On the Lake of Thun
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of J. Donald Ostrow
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with mountains in the distance. The horizon is in the middle of the image, with mountains rising from it. The scene has a soft appearance with smooth tones and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray. The water is calm with ripples reflecting light, and the sky has scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Jésus! Il vient de me passer une bête...
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Alan Ostrow
artworks.description: In the image titled "Les Lorettes," the heads of three women are visible as they are partially submerged in dark water. The women are positioned facing slightly towards each other. Each woman has distinct facial features and long dark hair falling over their shoulders. They appear to be engaged in conversation. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. Their expressions are neutral and their skin tone is even. The background shows a high, steep inclined bank lush with greenery and foliage. Above the bank are various items like light-colored towels and clothing. A solitary, thin tree trunk with sparse branches extends through the bank.

artworks.title: Cover for the Album Lithographique of 1835
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring three figures in theatrical costumes on a small stage. The scene shows a clown, another character in a coat and hat with a cane, and a drummer in a feathered hat and coat. A banner reads "Album Lithographique par Raffet" on the left, and a sign with the year "1835" is displayed above. The drawing uses shading to create depth and convey character expressions, capturing a playful, performative moment likely set in the mid-19th-century Parisian street performance scene.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Yves Zelnick

artworks.title: Adrien Perlet, Actor
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white gouache on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in memory of Adolph and Jeanne Zelnick
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up, facing slightly to the left with the head turned towards the viewer. The person has wavy or curly hair, defined facial features, and is dressed in a coat with large lapels and a scarf or cravat around the neck. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing, leaning slightly forward with his left hand resting on an open book on a table. He has fair skin, large eyes, and neatly combed dark hair. He is wearing a vintage long-sleeved coat with buttons and a light-colored bow at the neckline. The background is softly blurred neutral setting to resemble a serene cloudy sky. The photograph is framed in an oval cut-out with a dark red outer border and gold-toned inner matting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: In the image, there is a young girl standing in a full-body portrait. She has dark hair styled neatly into two buns with a middle parting. The girl is wearing a light pink knee-length dress with ruffled designs and floral details, featuring an off-the-shoulder neckline. She is holding a basket of colorful flowers in her left hand and has a delicate necklace with a small pendant. The background shows a painted backdrop with light clouds.

artworks.title: Église Notre Dame - Côté sud
artworks.creditLine: Clinton and Jean Wright Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a grand Gothic cathedral with detailed architecture featuring towering spires. The cathedral is shown from a side angle, emphasizing the use of flying buttresses along its façade. A large rose window is prominently displayed on the side. The two large towers at the front of the cathedral exhibit ornate detailing, and the roof of the building slopes steeply, with an array of lines and textures. In the foreground, along a waterway, there are smaller structures and what appears to be building materials.

artworks.title: Reward poster for escaped convict, John Hackett, Walla Walla, Washington
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a reward poster for an escaped convict. The upper section of the poster contains two black and white mugshot photographs of an individual with the profile and front view positioned side by side. Below the photographs are the words "REWARD" and "ESCAPED CONVICT!". The text details the escape from Meskill Rock Quarry and offers a $50 reward for the capture. The text outlines specifics about the individual such as physical description, identifying marks, and fingerprints. It includes a detailed account of the person’s criminal history, sentence, and escape circumstances. At the bottom of the poster is the name "Washington State Penitentiary, Walla Walla, Washington," indicating the penitentiary associated with the escapee.

artworks.title: Sir Leslie Stephen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Leslie, Judith, and Gabrielle  Schreyer
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a seated position with his arms crossed over his chest. He has a long, full beard and wavy medium-length hair, along with distinct facial features including a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. He is wearing a dark, tailored jacket with a visible lapel, a light-colored dress shirt, and a bow tie. The background is a smooth, slightly blurred monochrome.

artworks.title: Plate Number 665. Ass; walking; bareback; a boy riding, Jennie
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a donkey walking. The image shows a sequence of twelve black and white frames displaying the side-view progression of a donkey in motion, capturing a detailed study of its gait. The scene features a consistent grid background. The donkey is seen from left to right in various sequences of stepping, creating a visual narrative of movement across the grid-lined backdrop. The framing and composition are reminiscent of early motion studies.

artworks.title: Plate Number 705. Dog; trotting; mastiff, Dread
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a collection of sequential black and white stills showing a dog walking. The frames are arranged in a grid of five rows by six columns. Each row captures a different sequence of the dog's motion. The background includes a fence, and the setting appears to be outdoors. The dog is shown in various stages of its walk cycle, creating the illusion of fluid motion when viewed together. The series resembles early motion studies in photography.

artworks.title: Plate Number 712. Dog; jumping hurdle; mastiff, Dread
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a dog jumping over a fence. The image is a sequence of black and white frames arranged in two rows, capturing a large dog in motion as it approaches, leaps over, and lands on the other side of a fence. The dog is shown from various angles, providing a detailed study of its movements. The environment appears to be an enclosed area, likely with metal fencing visible in the background, under a natural or ambient source of light. The set-up suggests an early form of motion study or animal locomotion photography, focusing on capturing the precise mechanics of the animal's leap.

artworks.title: Sketches of Tombs
artworks.creditLine: New Century Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship and a statue sketch. The drawing consists of three distinct pencil sketches spread across a blank page. On the left side, two small sketches of ships are visible. Toward the center and right area of the page, there is a sketch of a statue standing on a pedestal. The statue is drawn in a simplified form, and a faint semicircle arcs over it. The overall appearance is minimalistic, with the sketches appearing unfinished or in draft form, focused on basic shapes and structures.

artworks.title: "Mr. & Mrs..."
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten de Vos
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Susan Hill in Honor of Curator Gregory Jecmen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with figures at the top of a cliff and a detailed cityscape below. The composition features two figures standing on a rocky outcrop on the left. The cliffside is textured with foliage and trees growing at various angles. Below the cliff, a landscape stretches out, showcasing a valley with rivers, towns, and distant mountains, under a sky filled with clouds. The line work and shading create depth and detail, reminiscent of the Dutch or Flemish school of the late Renaissance.

artworks.title: A Farm near the Sea at Margate, Kent
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with gum arabic
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Connie Simmons and James D. Krugman
artworks.description: The image displays rustic cottages surrounded by a pastoral landscape. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, with a meeting of the sky and distant trees and fields. The cottages have thatched and tiled roofs, painted with deliberate brushstrokes that capture the texture of the materials. The color palette consists of earthy tones like browns, greens, and greys, with a pale blue sky in the background. Patches of green grass and footpaths lead towards the central cottages, beyond which fields and trees stretch towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Views in the Navy Ordnance Yard, Washington, D.C., June
artworks.creditLine: Robert Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large outdoor storage area for naval torpedoes or bombs, with a two-story brick building and a single-story structure visible. The image depicts an orderly arrangement of numerous large cylindrical objects, aligned on the ground in parallel rows. The setting is an exterior yard, presumably part of a military or naval installation. In the foreground, the munitions are stacked neatly, each one resting on wooden cradles. The ground surface is bare and appears dusty, with paths perhaps made for transport. The buildings, one brick and the other a lighter construction, serve as a backdrop with windows and doors visible. Trees on the periphery provide a natural element within the industrial landscape.

artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures in a circular composition against a cloud-filled background. In the center, a figure is shown levitating with arms outstretched. Their face is partly obscured by an aura, with visible features of a bearded visage and long hair. Surrounding this central figure are two seated individuals draped in robes holding tablet-like objects. In the lower portion, three figures are shown in kneeling or seated poses with bowed or turned heads, clothed in robes. The background features swirling clouds.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Enthroned with a Bishop Saint and a Kneeling Ecclesiastic
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene. In the center is a figure seated on a throne or elevated chair, with a halo around their head. Another smaller figure is seated on their knee. To the left stands a figure in a robe with a pointed hat and staff. To the right, another figure bends forward. Below the central figure, two cherubic figures are depicted. The drawing is done in a monochrome palette of browns and sepia tones with delicate shading. A rectangular border frames the scene.

artworks.title: Jupiter Defeating the Giants
artworks.artist: attributed to Girolamo Faccioli, after Perino del Vaga
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two main sections. The upper section shows a group of figures surrounded by clouds in a celestial realm. A bearded figure sits centrally, with other figures gesturing around him. The lower section depicts figures in varied poses on rocky terrain, expressing turmoil or despair. The drawing is detailed and includes intricate shading, focusing on the physiques, drapery, and landscape.
